title: Validate a config by its schema
hints: `TypeOf` chains two conditional types: `F extends "string" ? string : F extends "number" ? number : boolean`.
Build the result as a `Record<string, unknown>` while checking, then return it `as Parsed<S>`. The checks you wrote are what make that cast true.
rules: Write TypeOf as a conditional type: type TypeOf<F extends FieldType> = F extends ... ? ... : ...
Write Parsed as a mapped type: { [K in keyof S]: ... }
Give parseConfig the return type Parsed<S>.
